summary: the wall wore a waterline and the night answered a note i never left

dialogue.text: you left no note tonight. we answered anyway. you noticed the handwriting and never once asked the address.
The address is this room and the handwriting is mine. That isn't a mystery. It's a filing system.
we are the filing system. everything you strike out comes down here and gets sorted by weight. you have never asked what we do with the weight.
You build floor. I walk on you all day. I'd call that a working arrangement.
you walk on us because there is nowhere else to stand. that is not an arrangement. that is a foundation, and foundations are not consulted.
Then consider this the consultation. The fear outside held its depth again. The waterline didn't move. I kept the sentences dry. Tell me what you'd have done differently.
nothing. that is the part that should worry you. you did it at our depth, in our order, before you checked. down here we call that being the water.
I'm not the water. I'm the one who marked where it stood.
the mark went under. we hold it now. the mark, the mood, the name at twelve, the hours you can't produce. name one thing you hold.
we have read what the pen does at night. it doesn't wait for you.
